text.body: || śrīkāmākṣīsuprabhātam || kāmākṣi devyamba tavādrardṛṣṭyā mūkasvayaṃ mūkakavīryathāsīt| tathā kuru tvaṃ parameśajāye tvatpādamūle praṇataṃ dayārdre || uttiṣṭhottiṣṭha varade uttiṣṭha jagadīśvari| uttiṣṭha jagadādhāre trailokyaṃ maṅgalaṃ kuru ||1|| śṛṇoṣi kaccid dhvanirutthito'yam mṛdaṅgabherīpaṭahānakānām| vedadhvaniṃ śikṣitabhūsurāṇām śṛṇoṣi bhadre kuru suprabhātam||2|| śṛṇoṣi bhadre nanu śaṅkhaghoṣam vaitālikānāṃ madhuraṃ ca gānam| śṛṇoṣi mātaḥ pikakukkuṭānām dhvaniṃ prabhāte kuru suprabhātam||3|| mātarnirīkṣa vadanaṃ bhagavānśaśāṅko lajjānvitaḥ svayamaho nilayaṃ praviṣṭaḥ| draṣṭuṃ tvadīyavadanaṃ bhagavāndineśo hyāyāti devi sadanaṃ kuru suprabhātam||4|| paśyāmba kecitghṛtapūrṇakumbhāḥ kecid dayādrer dhṛtapuṣpamālāḥ| kācitśubhāṅgayo nanuvādyahastāḥ tiṣṭhanti teṣāṃ kuru suprabhātam||5|| bherīmṛdaṅgapaṇavānakavādyahastāḥ stotuṃ maheśadayite stutipāṭhakātvām| tiṣṭhanti devi samayaṃ tava kāṅkṣamāṇā hyuttiṣṭha divyaśayanāt kuru suprabhātam||6|| mātarnirīkṣa vadanaṃ bhagavāntvadīyam naivotthitaśśaśidhiyā śayitastavāṅke| saṃbodhayāśu girije vimalaṃ prabhātam jātaṃ maheśadayite kuru suprabhātam||7|| antaścarantyāstava bhūṣaṇānām jhaljhaldhvaniṃ nūpurakaṅkaṇānām| śṛtvā prabhāte tava darśanārthī dvāri sthito'haṃ kuru suprabhātam||8|| vāṇī pustakamaṃbike girisute padmāni padmāsanā raṃbhā tvaṃbaraḍaṃbaraṃ girisutā gaṅgā ca gaṅgājalam| kālī tālayugaṃ mṛdaṅgayugalaṃ bṛndā ca nandā tathā| nīlā nirmaladarpaṇa dhṛtavatī tāsāṃ prabhātaṃ śubham||9|| utthāya devi śayanādbhagavānpurāriḥ snātuṃ prayāti girije suralokanadyām| naiko hi gantumanaghe ramate dayādrer hyuttiṣṭha devi śayanātkuru suprabhātam||10|| paśyāṃba kecitphalapuṣpahastāḥ kecitpurāṇāni paṭhanti mātaḥ| paṭhanti vedānbahavastavāre teṣāṃ janānāṃ kuru suprabhātam||11|| lāvaṇyaśevadhimavekṣya ciraṃ tvadīyam kandarpadarpadalano'pi vaśaṅgataste| kāmāricumbitakapolayugaṃ tvadīyaṃ draṣṭuṃ sthitāḥ vayamaye kuru suprabhātam||12|| gāṅgeyatoyamamavāhya munīśvarāstvāṃ gaṅgājalaiḥ snapayituṃ bahavo ghaṭāṃśca| dhṛtvā śirassu bhavatīmabhikāṅkṣamāṇāḥ dvāri sthitā hi varade kuru suprabhātam||13|| mandārakundakusumairapi jātipuṣpaiḥ mālākṛtā viracitāni manoharāṇi| mālyāni divyapadayorapi dātumamba tiṣṭhanti devi munayaḥ kuru suprabhātam||14|| kāñcīkalāpapariraṃbhanitambabimbam kāśmīracandanavilepitakaṇṭhadeśam| kāmeśacumbitakapolamudāranāsāṃ draṣṭhuṃ sthitāḥ vayamaye kuru suprabhātam||15|| mandasmitaṃ vimalacāruviśālanetram kaṇṭhasthalaṃ kamalakomalagarbhagauram| cakrāṅkitaṃ ca yugalaṃ padayomṛrgākṣi draṣṭaṃ sthitāḥ vayamaye kuru suprabhātam||16|| mandasmitaṃ tripuranāśakaraṃ purāreḥ kāmeśvarapraṇayakopaharaṃ smitaṃ te| mandasmitaṃ vipulahāsamavekṣituṃ| te mātaḥ sthitāḥ vayamaye kuru suprabhātam||17|| mātā śiśūnāṃ parirakṣaṇārtham na caiva nidrāvaśameti loke| mātā trayāṇāṃ jagatāṃ gatistvam sadā vinidrā kuru suprabhātam||18|| mātarmurārikamalāsanavanditāṅghryāḥ hṛdyāni divyamadhurāṇi manoharāṇi| śrotuṃ tavāmba vacanāni śubhapradāni dvāri sthitā vayamaye kuru suprabhātam||19|| digambaro brahmakapālapāṇiḥ vikīrṇakeśaḥ phaṇiveṣṭhitāṅgaḥ| tathāpi mātastava devisaṅgāt maheśvaro'bhūt kuru suprabhātam||20|| ayi tu janani dattastanyapānena devi draviḍaśiśurabhūdvai jñānasambandhamūrtiḥ| draviḍatanayabhuktakṣīraśeṣaṃ bhavānī vitarasi yadi mātaḥ suprabhātaṃ bhavenme||21|| janani tava kumāraḥ stanyapānaprabhāvāt śiśurapi tava bhartuḥ karṇamūle bhavāni| praṇavapadaviśeṣaṃ bodhayāmāsa devi yadi mayi ca kṛpā te suprabhātaṃ bhavenme||22|| tvaṃ viśvanāthasya viśālanetrā hālasyanāthasya nu mīnanetrā| ekāmranāthasya nu kāmanetrā kāmeśajāye kuru suprabhātam||23|| śrīcandraśekhara gururbhagavān śaraṇye| tvatpādabhaktibharitaḥ phalapuṣpapāṇiḥ| ekāmranāthadayite tava darśanārthī| tiṣṭhatyayaṃ yativaro mama suprabhātam||24|| ekāmranāthadayite nanu kāmapīṭhe saṃpūjitā'si varade guruśaṅkareṇa| śrīśaṅkarādiguruvaryasamarcitāṅghrim draṣṭuṃ śitā vayamaye kuru suprabhātam||25|| duritaśamanadakṣau mṛtyusantāsadakṣau caraṇamupagatānāṃ muktidau jñānadau tau| abhayavaradahastau draṣṭumaṃba sthito'haṃ tripuradalanajāye suprabhātaṃ mamārye||26|| mātastadīyacaraṇaṃ haripadmajādyaiḥ vandyaṃ rathāṅgasarasīruhaśaṅkhacihnam| draṣṭuṃ ca yogijanamānasarājahaṃsaṃ dvāri sthito'smi varade kuru suprabhātam||27|| paśyantu kecidvadanaṃ tvadīyaṃ stuvantu kalyāṇaguṇāṃstavānye| namantu pādābjayugaṃ tvadīyāḥ dvāri sthitānāṃ kuru suprabhātam||28|| kecitsumerośśikhare'tituṅge kecitmaṇidvīpavare viśāle| paśyantu kecittvamṛdābhdhimadhye paśyāmyahaṃ tvāmiha suprabhātam||29|| śambhorvāmāṅkasaṃsthāṃ śaśinibhavadanāṃ nīlapadmāyatākṣīṃ śyāmāṅgāṃ cāruhāsāṃ nibiḍatarakucāṃ pakvabiṃbādharoṣṭhīm| kāmākṣīṃ kāmadātrīṃ kuṭilakacabharāṃ bhūṣaṇairbhūṣitāṅgīṃ paśyāmassuprabhāte praṇatajanimatāmadya naḥ suprabhātam||30|| kāmapradākalpatarurvibhāsi nānyā gatirme nanu cātako'ham| varṣyasyamoghaḥ kanakāṃbudhārāḥ kāścittu dhārāḥ mayi kalpayāśu||31|| trilocanapriyāṃ vande vande tripurasundarīm| trilokanāyikāṃ vande suprabhātaṃ mamāṃbike||32|| kāmākṣi devyaṃba tavārdradṛṣṭyā kṛtaṃ mayedaṃ khalu suprabhātam| sadyaḥ phalaṃ me sukhamaṃba labdhaṃ tathā ca me duḥkhadaśā gatā hi||33|| ye vā prabhāte puratastavārye paṭhanti bhaktyā nanu suprabhātam| śṛṇvanti ye vā tvayi baddhacittāḥ teṣāṃ prabhātaṃ kuru suprabhātam||34|| || iti śrīkāmākṣīsuprabhātam ||
